about_the_game:
Summary

The protagonist, who works for a newspaper company, is unable to write a good article and finds himself in a situation where there is no end in sight. In the midst of all this, one piece of information suddenly comes to him. It is that an experiment is being conducted at a famous research institute in defiance of the law. The protagonist visits the institute to take advantage of this big opportunity. However, he regrets his visit...

Let's collect all the materials!

There are a total of 8 documents scattered around the stage. Each of them contains information about the tracker, so let's find out the big news while gaining knowledge about the tracker!

Let's find the key card!

Naturally, the materials are located in the rooms, but some of the doors are closed. To open the doors of those rooms, you will need the card keys. Let's find the card key along with the documents!

Avoid the tracker's pursuit!

The tracker will be chasing you for a long time. There are several safe zones in the stage, so if you are spotted, move to a safe zone immediately!

Let's watch multiple endings!

When you reach the ending, the contents of the ending will change depending on the items you have in your possession. Can you view all the endings and see the good ending?
